sections.title: Describe different conditions
sections.content: You know the weather phrases from the last lesson. Now ask *¿Qué tiempo hace?*, add *hace fresco* and talk about the sky with *hay nubes*.

sections.title: Common conditions
rows: There are clouds in the sky.

items.english: What is the weather like today?
There are clouds in the sky.

sections.content: Here *tiempo* means "weather", not "time". Answer *¿Qué tiempo hace?* with a complete phrase: *Hace fresco*, *Llueve*, *Está nublado*.
